subject: SSC: can't fit more components than number of pixels

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: SSC: can't fit more components than number of pixels
parts:
Hi,

running SSC on a small test file I got this message: can't fit more components than number of pixels.
This quite strange as the file has 9 pixels and I was trying to get only two clusters:

File: https://ms-imaging.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/Example_Continuous_imzML1.1.1.zip

  ex_cont = readImzML(name="Example_Continuous")
  ncol(ex_cont) #9
  ssc = spatialShrunkenCentroids(ex_cont, r=2, k=2, s=0, method="gaussian")

On normal files I did not get this error, so probably not an urgent thing to solve...

Best,
Melanie

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: SSC: can't fit more components than number of pixels
parts:
SSC is initialized by spatialKMeans() which automatically sets the number of Fastmap components to 10 for dimension reduction prior to clustering...

I've updated spatialFastmap() to check the number of components against both the number of features and number of pixels (it was only checking against the number of features before). So this should be technically fixed now, although the results for that trivial example are likely meaningless.

-Kylie
